upstream.test: should be able to use import
adaptations: Remove the it wrapper, done callback, redundant outer Promise, and nsObj helper; retain dynamic import and its Promise continuation.
Observe the namespace default value instead of exact namespace keys/prototype, which differ between native Node versions and bundler runtimes.

Add sync-before/sync-after console markers around import() and an evaluate marker immediately before the original module.exports assignment. These extra observations make the async boundary and dependency-before-continuation order explicit; they were not upstream assertions.
Rename two.js to two.cjs, make the import extension explicit, and add files/package.json with type module.
Add a rejection handler that throws on a later microtask, ensuring load failure exits unsuccessfully without a test framework.
Preserve webpack's MIT notice in LICENSE.webpack and rspack's original THIRD-PARTY-LICENSE; see NOTES.incremental-bundler.rspack.md for verified webpack counterpart paths.

goals: Dynamic import returns before executing the imported dependency and resolves after evaluation.
A dynamically imported CommonJS primitive is exposed through namespace.default.
Preserve the asynchronous semantic boundary without prescribing chunks, filenames, or a loading runtime.
